verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis for a SaaS platform that stores contact and campaign data, so the axis applies. The pack only documents generating an account export (docs-16), which is about portability. Nothing documents user-controlled deletion endpoints, contact or data erasure, or configurable retention periods. The community reports describe Mailchimp deleting accounts on its own initiative, which is the opposite of user control and not evidence of the capability.
